column1: # Website monitor targets (webmon/webmon.py). Edits apply within 30 s
# name         short label shown in Grafana (letters
# url          full image URL on our website (http or https)
# interval_min average minutes between checks of this image (min 1; please keep >= 5 for a public site)
# jitter_pct   each gap is interval +/- this percentage
# cache_bust   yes = add a random ?archmon=... so CDN/browser caches are skipped and the origin server is measured
#              no  = measure what a visitor normally gets (cached copy if the site uses a CDN)
